title: These New Snails Can Slam Shut Their Shells Like Doors - Nautilus
author: David Nield
text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementZoologyThese New Snails Can Slam Shut Their Shells Like DoorsIt’s always good to have the option of some peace and quietDNBy David Nield2:30 PM CDT on October 12, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleMost of us who have been teenagers know the unique satisfaction of seeking refuge behind a shut door. So do these two new snail species in Montenegro that boast tiny openings on their shells that can be closed like doors.After a hard day of slowly sliming around the neighborhood, it must be a relief to shut out the rest of the world and get some peace and quiet. These openings (or “operculum”) are common in freshwater and sea snails, but not in European land snails like the two found here—a clue to the ancestry of the species.Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
